title: Station Authored Instance
description: Schema for a crafting station instance. Stations enable specific recipes per ADR-0005 and recipe.schema.json. Lives in stations/<station_id>/data.json. The Entity Directory contains data.json plus scene.tscn for the world representation of the station block/structure.

tech_tier.description: Tech tier this station represents. Determines which recipes it can support and which player skill levels can use it.

size_in_blocks.description: Dimensions in voxel blocks. Used for placement validation and world-rendering scale.

scene.description: scene:* URN of the visual representation. The scene file lives alongside data.json in the Entity Directory.

recipes_supported.description: Recipe URNs that can be crafted at this station. Recipes also declare station_required; both must agree at runtime.

power_requirement.description: What's needed to operate this station.

intensity.description: Magnitude required. Manual = player effort time; steam = boiler pressure; tesla = voltage; magical_ley = ley line proximity.

skill_required.description: Optional. Player prerequisites for operating this station. Currently constrained to tech_tier; a skill_level system may arrive later, but is not yet specced and is omitted from MVP.

construction_recipe.description: Recipe URN that constructs this station. The player crafts the station itself via this recipe before they can use it.

durability.description: Hit points of the station structure. Damage from combat, weather, or cosmic horror reduces it. At zero, the station breaks.
